notes: V1.0.2 inspection principle: fixed values are compared with the SPEC/Profile.
Variable fields are read from the actual label and validated by format and relationship rules.
S/N, MAC, GPON S/N and QR content are variable values; SPEC examples are not used as per-unit expected values.
P/N and Made in may additionally be compared with work-order input when provided.
Each checklist item must receive the same valid result twice before LOCK; stable wrong value requires three confirmations before CONFIRMED_FAIL.
HID scanner can lock deterministic barcode/QR items immediately via two internal confirmations.
V1.1.1 LOCK is a terminal state. Recognition cannot auto-unlock or overwrite a locked value.
Start/Stop Live Scan preserves locks. Only New Unit / Reset Locks or Manual Unlock can clear them.
Live recognition uses latest-frame-only strategy and skips already locked items.
Live mode uses selective ROI OCR/Barcode/QR instead of full-label OCR every cycle.
V1.2.0 implements actual Progressive Zone Scan: A -> B -> C1 -> C2 -> C3 -> D.
PASS 1/2 survives unreadable/blur frames; only another valid PASS value replaces the candidate, or candidate TTL expires.
Zone D is camera-free rule evaluation using locked values.
GUI guides the operator to the current camera target zone.
V1.3.0 Hybrid Architecture: machine-readable Barcode/QR uses a separate full-frame direct zxingcpp pipeline modeled after the proven FQC Tool.
Barcode/QR no longer depends on Label Detection, perspective correction, Zone ROI, preprocessing variants or OCR.
Guided Zones are now dedicated to printed-text OCR only.
Fast machine-readable pipeline and slow OCR pipeline run independently in parallel.
Camera default restored to the proven FQC 1280x720 setting for live speed/stability.
V1.4.0 Printed Text live pipeline no longer uses Label Detection, perspective correction, corrected-label ROI, or automatic Zone rotation.
Operator-visible yellow target box is exactly the image crop sent to RapidOCR.
Guided OCR advances only after the current printed item LOCKS, or by explicit operator Next/Previous.
S/N, MAC and GPON human-readable OCR use already LOCKED barcode values as ground truth.
WiFi Key and SSID use decoded WiFi QR / locked MAC as ground truth when available.
Fixed descriptive text uses tolerant OCV/fuzzy or structured-value matching rather than exact full OCR substring.
Fast full-frame Barcode/QR pipeline from V1.3.0 remains unchanged.
V1.4.1 changes only operator guidance / Direct Guided OCR target-window presentation.
OCR target windows are centered and sized by item type; single-line text uses a narrow horizontal window.
Added Live OCR Target Zoom showing the exact crop sent to OCR.
Added center crosshair and target state colors: red/searching, yellow/detected, green/locked.
FastMachineReader, zxingcpp full-frame Barcode/QR, parser, camera capture and Smart Lock modules are protected from modification in this release.
V1.4.2 GUI fix: complete 16:9 camera image must remain visible; no top-only crop.
OCR Target Zoom is compact and height-capped.
FastMachineReader, CameraManager, Parser and SmartLock are unchanged and protected by SHA-256 regression gate.
V1.5.0 isolates RapidOCR/ONNX Runtime in a restartable child process.
Live Guided OCR does not start until OCR runtime preflight completes successfully.
Each OCR call has START/END logs and a hard timeout; a hung OCR process is terminated and restarted.
FastMachineReader, CameraManager, Parser and SmartLock remain protected and unchanged.
GitHub build now executes OCR inference from the packaged Windows EXE before artifact upload.
V1.5.1 fixes Worker->Tk transport using an in-process thread-safe Queue.
OCR, machine reader and OCR preflight workers never call Tk.after() or update widgets directly.
Only Tk main thread drains WorkerResultBus and runs merge/SmartLock/UI updates.
Adds QUEUE_PUT/QUEUE_GET/RULE_EVAL/SMART_LOCK_RESULT end-to-end trace.
V1.5.2 eliminates remaining Tk/Tcl cross-thread reads by snapshotting expected values, known fields and target data in the Tk main thread.
Guided OCR worker receives only frame + plain Python snapshots and never calls self._expected() or Tk Variable.get().
V1.5.3 fixes confirmed root cause: app.py used re.sub() in _merge_guided_result without importing re, causing NameError after QUEUE_GET.
Main-thread merge exceptions are now written to debug.log, test.log and execution.log with full traceback.
DirectGuidedOCR no longer silently converts OCR backend exceptions into empty OCR text.
V1.6.0 Production Mode uses four multi-field OCR zones; one OCR inference evaluates multiple existing V1.5.3 field rules.
Manual Item Debug mode retains the V1.5.3 single-item workflow for engineering troubleshooting.
Completion automatically saves result.json and Label_Inspection_Report_<session>.xlsx.
FastMachineReader, SmartLock, CameraManager, Parser, OCR runtime, WorkerBus and DirectGuidedOCR remain protected.
V1.6.1 build-quality fix: GitHub static gate now targets Ruff F821 undefined names; four unused imports were removed without changing inspection logic.
V1.6.2 GUI fix: Zone guidance moved into the right result pane; Production mode hides OCR Target Zoom and uses compact zone status so the full Camera preview retains usable height.
V1.7.0 multi-label profile architecture: profile-driven custom OCR targets allow additional label types without rewriting the core scheduler.
V1.7.5 Artwork operator guide uses whole-label outline plus broad anchors; small-logo contour matching is machine-only.
V1.7.5 uses PASS/VERIFY/FAIL dead-bands to reduce frame-to-frame false NG near shape/position thresholds.
V1.7.6.1 Chassis CLASS 1 LASER PRODUCT uses normalized-label targeted OCR; session Excel is saved on PASS and manual stop/incomplete runs.
V1.7.9 Image Label Inspection uses guided multi-photo evidence: Full Label + Basic + WiFi + Identity + Compliance. Partial close-ups are not forced through full-label registration.
V1.7.9 fuses raw facts across photos and re-runs session-level relationship rules; full-label overview supplies artwork position while close-ups may supply artwork shape evidence.

required_items: Variable: GPON S/N Human Readable Format
Consistency: GPON S/N Text vs Barcode
Rule: GPON S/N = Prefix + MAC Last 8
Consistency: QR SSID vs Printed SSID
Consistency: QR Key vs Printed WiFi Key

zones.title: ZONE A - Basic / Fixed Information
zones.instruction: Keep the whole label visible. Make the LEFT-UPPER basic information area sharp: Model / P-N / IP / Username / Input / USB / Made in.

zones.title: ZONE B - WiFi / Password / QR
zones.instruction: Printed-text OCR only. Make Password / WiFi Key / SSID clear. WiFi QR is decoded independently by the Fast Machine Read pipeline.

zones.title: ZONE C1 - S/N
zones.instruction: Printed-text OCR only. Focus the S/N human-readable text. The S/N Code128 barcode is decoded independently from the full camera frame.

zones.title: ZONE C2 - MAC
zones.instruction: Printed-text OCR only. Focus the MAC human-readable text. The MAC Code128 barcode is decoded independently from the full camera frame.

zones.title: ZONE C3 - GPON S/N
zones.instruction: Printed-text OCR only. Focus the GPON S/N human-readable text. The GPON Code128 barcode is decoded independently from the full camera frame.
items: Variable: GPON S/N Human Readable Format

zones.title: ZONE D - Automatic Cross Check
zones.instruction: No camera movement is required. The program cross-checks values already LOCKED from previous zones.
items: Consistency: GPON S/N Text vs Barcode
Rule: GPON S/N = Prefix + MAC Last 8
Consistency: QR SSID vs Printed SSID
Consistency: QR Key vs Printed WiFi Key

production_zones.title: ZONE A - Basic Information
production_zones.instruction: 請將 Label 上方基本資訊完整放入黃色區域。一次辨識 GPON / Model / P/N / Input / USB / IP / Username。

production_zones.title: ZONE B - Wi-Fi Information
production_zones.instruction: 請將 Password / WiFi Key / SSID 區域完整放入黃色區域。WiFi QR 由 Full-frame Reader 獨立掃描。

production_zones.title: ZONE C - Device Identity
production_zones.instruction: 請將 S/N / MAC / GPON S/N 人眼文字區域完整放入黃色區域。Barcode 由 Full-frame Reader 獨立掃描。
items: Variable: GPON S/N Human Readable Format

production_zones.title: ZONE D - Compliance / Artwork
production_zones.instruction: 請將完整 Chassis Label 保持在 Camera 可見範圍；程式檢查 Made in / 地址 / CLASS 1 LASER PRODUCT，並判定 COMTREND / Recycling / RoHS / CE / WEEE 的形狀與相對位置。圖形尺寸大小不判定。
